魔犹伊的遗失物说明：每个山洞深处都有一只魔犹伊（Bubbulfrog），击败后掉落魔犹伊的遗失物（Bubbul Gem）。收集后可在夜晚找到柯尔天（Koltin）兑换怪物面具与神秘套装。山洞入口在地图上显示为洞穴图标，找到附近的樱花树（Satori Tree）放置果实，可点亮该区域所有山洞入口。坐标说明：游戏内按 M 打开地图，右下角显示当前坐标（X, Y, Z）。

About Bubbul Gems: deep inside every cave lives a Bubbulfrog; defeating it drops a Bubbul Gem. Collected gems can be exchanged at night with Koltin for monster masks and the Mystic Set. Cave entrances appear on the map as cave icons; place fruit beside a nearby cherry blossom tree (Satori Tree) to reveal all cave entrances in that area. About coordinates: press M in-game to open the map; your current coordinates (X, Y, Z) are shown at the bottom right.

🎁 柯尔天兑换奖励（完整列表）
柯尔天（Koltin）是基尔顿的弟弟，相信吃下魔犹伊的遗失物能让他变成魔犹伊。首次在鲁皮湖的洞窟附近（林地驿站旁，坐标 1247, 1232, 0037）遇见他，完成支线任务「寻找柯尔天」后，他会在夜晚（21:00–05:00）出现于海拉鲁各地轮换摊位。柯尔天每次只卖一件物品，按固定顺序轮换，需多次拜访。全部常规奖励共需累计 46 个遗失物；集齐全部 147 个后可获得特殊结局奖励。

Koltin is Kilton's younger brother, and he believes eating Bubbul Gems will turn him into a Bubbulfrog. You first meet him near Pico Pond Cave (beside Woodland Stable, coordinates 1247, 1232, 0037); after completing the side quest “Find Koltin,” he appears at rotating stalls across Hyrule at night (21:00–05:00). Koltin sells only one item at a time, in a fixed rotation, so you will need to visit him multiple times. All regular rewards require a cumulative total of 46 gems; collecting all 147 earns a special ending reward.

交出全部 147 个遗失物后，柯尔天皮肤变蓝，化身为蓝色精灵（Blupee）消失。之后前往塔雷镇告知基尔顿，可触发支线任务结局。此后柯尔天的摊位会永久出现在魔犹伊山的樱花树旁。

After handing over all 147 Bubbul Gems, Koltin's skin turns blue and he transforms into a Blupee and vanishes. Afterwards, go to Tarrey Town and tell Kilton to trigger the side quest ending. From then on, Koltin's stall permanently appears beside the cherry blossom tree on Bubbul Mountain.

精灵套装（Mystic Set）效果：精灵服 + 精灵裤子 + 精灵头饰，套装特效为卢比护盾（Rupee Padding）——受到伤害时优先消耗卢比而非生命值，卢比耗尽后才扣血。无法在大仙女喷泉强化。怪物面具效果：佩戴对应面具后，该种类怪物不会主动攻击，可用于潜入怪物营地。注意：柯尔天仅在夜晚（21:00–05:00）出现，白天不在摊位。可在塔雷镇找基尔顿获取柯尔天当前位置提示。

Mystic Set effect: Mystic Robe + Mystic Trousers + Mystic Headpiece; the set bonus is Rupee Padding — when you take damage, Rupees are consumed first instead of hearts, and hearts are only lost once your Rupees run out. It cannot be enhanced at a Great Fairy Fountain. Monster mask effect: wearing the matching mask means monsters of that type will not attack you unprovoked, which is useful for infiltrating monster camps. Note: Koltin appears only at night (21:00–05:00) and is not at his stall during the day. You can ask Kilton in Tarrey Town for a hint about Koltin's current location.

🗺 海拉鲁大陆 · 山洞互动地图
地图上的点是入口：天空 8、地表 189，共 197 个 · 点任意入口都跳到同一洞窟
Map markers are entrances: 8 sky, 189 surface, 197 total · Clicking any entrance jumps to the same cave

洞窟数和地图点数为什么不一样？本站共 147 个洞窟，但地图上有 197 个点，因为地图上的点是入口，不是洞窟个数：一个洞窟有多个入口时，地图上就会有多个点，点任意一个入口都会跳到同一个洞窟行。天空图层：4 个洞窟 × 每洞 2 个入口 = 8 个点（无尽的洞窟、竖穴的洞窟、池边的洞窟、采矿的洞窟，均在大天空岛）；地表图层：143 个洞窟、189 个入口。魔犹伊仍然是每洞 1 只，共 147 只。

Why do the cave count and the map marker count differ? This site lists 147 caves, but there are 197 markers on the map, because the markers are entrances, not caves: when a cave has multiple entrances, it gets multiple markers, and clicking any entrance jumps to the same cave row. Sky layer: 4 caves × 2 entrances each = 8 markers (Bottomless Cave, Pit Cave, Pondside Cave, and Mining Cave, all on the Great Sky Island); surface layer: 143 caves, 189 entrances. There is still 1 Bubbulfrog per cave, 147 in total.
